prompt: The camera moves steadily forward along a narrow, fog-laden path flanked by tall, leafless trees, creating an eerie and isolated atmosphere. As the viewer progresses, the path curves gently to the right, bordered by a dark metal fence that runs parallel to the left side. The dense fog obscures much of the surrounding landscape, but the silhouettes of the trees and the faint outlines of distant structures become intermittently visible through the mist. The camera continues its advance, revealing a small wooden building on the right, partially shrouded in fog, with a few dim lights glowing softly from within. The path then leads into a more open area where the fog thickens, enveloping the scene in a uniform grayish-white haze. The camera pans slightly to the left, showing another building with a traditional Japanese architectural style, featuring a sloped roof and wooden walls, also illuminated by subtle interior lighting. The entire scene is bathed in a muted, monochromatic light, enhancing the sense of solitude and quietude. The camera maintains a steady, forward-moving angle throughout, capturing the tranquil yet mysterious ambiance of the night-time setting in Yamadera, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan.
